constraints: No true hidden hands at decision time
Full-information solver used only on sampled worlds
No B0 or R9 runtime changed
nearest_gate: Bounded belief/search cardplay treatment with paired B0 gameplay
next_gate: Preserve raw per-case pilot evidence; design one paired B0 gameplay treatment with deployment-matched latency and explicit fallback for unsupported states
pilot_initial_signal: 49/60 sampled-world actions match offline teacher vs 23/60 first legal; no failures
scientific_limit: Agreement with a perfect-information teacher on a small train pilot is not deployment strength, belief calibration, or promotion evidence
treatment: For basic contracts at at most three cards per seat, enumerate hidden card allocations compatible with own hand, known skat, played cards and public voids; sample up to 32 worlds and average exact endgame action values
